Reminder: we’ve added a new public branch named ‘previous_game_version’ for War Mongrels, which allows you to play the last game version, pre-patched. [list]
    [*]Select the game from your Steam game library (not the store page).
    [*]Click with the right mouse button on War Mongrels and select ‘properties’.

    [*]In the settings, move to the right side or down – depending on your Steam version: Properties -> Beta -> Select Beta version, and choose the desired version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38629372/e37fbef6df339d2e43390e14bcb3015ae26fa72d.png[/img]
[/list]
It will update the game (rollback to the previous version) of the game.

[previewyoutube=DZKbcCspuSg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: In memory of...
notes.content:
[h3]His little girl...

He was not there when German missiles took away someone so dear... He was willing to burn the world for her…

His dear sister Anna! 🧸

“In memory of all those who gave their lives fighting for freedom!”[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38629372/97fc23eebdf96a019a292c4336f46736b18fe09e.jpg[/img]

[i]Suburbs of Caen, France

19.06.1944

Dear Jerzy,

Damn weather! We are facing a major problem: we are heavily dependent on supplies of life, equipment, ammunition and fuel from artificial harbours. Due to the poor weather, support is limited. I have heard that the waves destroy the caissons of the outer jetties. The confusion is immense in two artificial ports: boats also run aground, some sink and floating bridges break their moorings. The supply of the front is extremely delayed! I’m hungry so I’m going to sleep a little bit longer…

Your loving,

Anna[/i]

notes.title: In memory of...
notes.content:
[h3]But from now on, Jerzy had only one thing on his mind… 😲[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38629372/760f2b83de8700e3a5c9d93f14c2eb72954bc22a.png[/img]

[i]Suburbs of Caen, France

18.06.1944

Dear Jerzy,

North and northwest of Caen are absorbed with fightings between the mechanized infantry divisions. Additionally, the situation is disastrous for our allied airmen who do not have enough territory to install advanced landing grounds. The general is getting nervous. Greta’s trying to cheer me up by telling me stories about her unusual friends - Manfred and Joachim. Manfred is a German deserter, please give him a chance when you will meet him in Warsaw. The fighting on the Eastern front changed him. No, I don’t have a crush on him you silly!

Your loving,
Anna[/i]

notes.title: In memory of...
notes.content:
[h3]If only these two were allowed to meet each other in different circumstances… 💕
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38629372/2cdb79d62e7f33b94bd9125e8d69e7ee1da600e0.png[/img]

[i]Suburbs of Caen, France

17.06.1944

Dear Jerzy,

The German lines of defence north of Caen hold good and do not seem to want to break. We are violently pushed back by tanks and the artillery. But I have good news as well, I think I found you a wife! Her name is Alicja, pseudonym “Greta”. She is also a liaison officer like me! Green eyes, dark hair, short stature, higher education and big personal charm, you always talked about such a woman! Jerzy, Alicja also belongs to the AK and will be returning to Warsaw soon, you have to meet her! 

Your loving,
Anna[/i]

notes.title: In memory of...
notes.content:
[h3]However, she turned out to be a real friend by delivering the letters… ✉️[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38629372/0d2781a8d7753c51db746630849517e8473c4a2a.png[/img]

[i]Suburbs of Caen, France

16.06.1944

Dear Jerzy,

In response to the London bombing tonight, King George VI came to France. Supposedly more than 200 V-1 missiles hit the island. My hunch, however, tells me that parents are safe! And you know I’m a clairvoyant, same as I predicted that you will not go with us to England. I still admire that you found the courage to stay and fight in the AK, but I just miss you. General arranged for us the aviation support, we are about to attack Caen!

Your loving,
Anna[/i]

notes.title: In memory of...

[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38629372/055f75f3fa2f1f21b5f2475bb4710c72c3ebc2ee.png[/img]

[i]Direction - Villers-Bocage, France

15.06.1944

Dear Jerzy,

Today, with armoured units, we tried to break through the front in the direction of Villers-Bocage. It was going great and the plan prepared by the general seemed to work. Unfortunately, just before our destination, we fell into an ambush. German Tiger tanks were everywhere, they were waiting for us! As a liaison, I was asked to withdraw and pass the coordinates for our artillery. Let the rain fall on those damned Tigers!

Your loving,
Anna[/i]

notes.title: In memory of...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38629372/f4c36a8749eca385d15c31d6b6bc7ac025a5f215.png[/img]

[i]Breville-les-Monts, France

14.06.1944

Dear Jerzy,

The general was right, Germans launched the first 10 V-1 missiles towards London today. Fortunately, the parents are safe! I stayed up all night worrying about them. Intelligence found out that Germans set up defences in all directions in the Amaye-sur-Seulles - Tracy-Bocage - St-Germain. I need some sleep, I miss our home in Warsaw, our children's room, our beds. I'll never get used to falling asleep to the sound of gunshots…

Your loving,
Anna[/i]

notes.title: In memory of...
notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38629372/48194b08b796cdf2de8a2debcbfc62764626cacd.png[/img]

Yesterday night by the order of Major-General Richard Nelson Gale, we eventually reached and secured the Breville! Changelist 42052:
[list]

[*][Tweak] Greta's 'Charm' ability now has a cooldown. Additionally, her other abilities are blocked while 'Charm' is being used.
[*][Tweak] Scrolling the in-game chat no longer causes the camera to zoom in or out when the chat reaches its end.
[*][Tweak] The conditions of challenge 'Complete the mission remaining undetected' have been clarified. In order to complete this challenge you must not be noticed by the enemy. Alarms can be invoked.

[*][Tweak] Tweaks to shooting from a crouched position.
[*][Tweak] Enemies are much better shooters when they lie on the ground. Be warned :)

[*][Tweak] Lukas's trap works on dogs.
[*][Tweak] Improvements to dog combat behavior.
[*][Tweak] Lukas and Lead can no longer disarm mines.
[*][Tweak] Improvements to patrolling logic, specifically when the enemies must return to their patrol route.
[*][Tweak] Gasoline environmental kill now causes some noise.
[*][Tweak] Melee combat in combat mode was nerfed. And versus dogs it will always miss, unless the dog is busy biting someone.
[*][Tweak] Greta's 'Gas' ability can now be used on NPCs too.
[*][Tweak] Several tweaks to civilian zones and disguises - shooting your way out under those conditions will no longer be so easy.
[*][Tweak] Using a manhole now counts as a suspicious activity.
[*][Tweak] Further improvements in AI pathing, specifically in relation to decoys and noises.
[*][Tweak] Death animation no longer plays after an automatic load.
[*][Tweak] Bullets are now destroyed before the game is saved. It was possible to save with the bullet flying at the hero and killing him instantly after the load, making such save unusable and the autoload after death feature pointless.
[/list][list]

[*][Bugfix] In rare situations combat started automatically when one of the enemies climbed a ladder. This behavior has been corrected.
[*][Bugfix] Fixed an issue with enemies improperly reacting upon finding a dead body.
[*][Bugfix] Characters sometimes shoot through obstacles when prone, due to how we calculated point of origin for shooting. This has been corrected.
[*][Bugfix] Fixed an issue with achievements not being unlocked retroactively in some cases.
[*][Bugfix] Ewald's 'Brawl' ability is no longer usable through walls.
[*][Bugfix] Multiple collision fixes - shooting through obstacles, seeing through geometry, and similar.
[*][Bugfix] Dogs will now properly react to their master's death, even if some other AI will react to that death event first.
[*][Bugfix] Civilian NPCs no longer use combat VO.
[*][Bugfix] Fixed handling of character animations on clients.
[*][Bugfix] Fixed a few bugs related to enemy line of sight rules.
[*][Bugfix] Fixed an issue with keyboard shortcuts for executing planned actions in planning mode.
[*][Bugfix] Autosaves triggered by quest progress will no longer happen when you disable Autosaves in the options.
[*][Bugfix] Key icons will now consistently stay the same on a specific key, regardless of save or load actions.

[*][Bugfix] Loading the game with characters hidden inside a manhole or door will no longer cause getting detected by enemies.
[*][Bugfix] Vision markers are now properly cleared after loading a saved game state.
[*][Bugfix] Loading the game when in state of combat will no longer allow enemies to ignore heroes.
[*][Bugfix] Crane environmental kill now properly resets when loading a saved game state and allows the client to use it again.
[*][Bugfix] Barrel environmental kill now works properly after loading a saved game state.
[*][Bugfix] Minedetector is no longer being left in the hand after loading a saved game state. It respects the position it was in when the save occured.
[*][Bugfix] Ammo crates now properly restore their state when loading the game. You can now pick them up again after load.
[*][Bugfix] Animation of using a medkit will no longer become stuck when loading a game.
[*][Bugfix] Player playing as a client couldn't pick up a body, if prior to loading a game he hid it. This has been corrected.
[*][Bugfix] Chapter II - Quest markers will now be properly positioned on the screen.
[*][Bugfix] Chapter II - Quest 'Man the MG42' will no longer activate twice after leaving the spot and loading the game.
[*][Bugfix] Chapter III - Fixed synchronization of enemy patrol routes after throwing a decoy.
[*][Bugfix] Chapter III - Non-interactive elements will no longer be highlighted.
[*][Bugfix] Chapter IV - Collision improvements, no more shooting through things you shouldn't be able to.

[*][Bugfix] Chapter IV - Greta will not 'Charm' dead soldiers anymore.
[*][Bugfix] Chapter V - Watchtower guard will no longer occasionally become stuck in the wall.
[*][Bugfix] Chapter V - Greta now properly stands in her position while talking to the doctor.
[*][Bugfix] Chapter V - Guard waits properly for Greta, before escorting her back to her cell.
[*][Bugfix] Chapter VI - Papers will no longer magically reappear after being picked up when loading a saved game state.
[*][Bugfix] Chapter VI - Skipping the cut-scene in a specific moment will no longer break truck logic and path, which effectively corrects it's position to the designed one.
[*][Bugfix] Chapter VI - Eavesdropping will not count if you are being observed.

notes.title: Future update schedule and claim your FREE OST
notes.content:
We’d like to update you on where we are with post-release updates. As you’ve seen so far, we’ve been actively patching the game in order to improve stability, address gameplay issues you’ve raised, as well as to get rid of all the bugs you’ve reported.

Going forward, [b]we’ll be patching War Mongrels twice a week[/b]. One patch will be focusing on stability and optimization, while the second patch will (typically) include mostly gameplay improvements. We’re going to stick to this plan until we’re fully happy with the state of the game.

[b]Please make sure to keep your game up-to-date! Also, ensure that you have the latest version of War Mongrels before [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1101790/discussions/0/2956041222215104469/]reporting a bug[/url].[/b] It’s going to help us immensely when sifting through your reports.

As a thank you for your reports, patience, and support at launch, we’ve also [b]released a free War Mongrels OST DLC[/b]. It’s going to be available to claim for a limited time, so pick it up now! The music was created by Adam Skorupa, our dear friend and acclaimed composer known for The Witcher, Painkiller, Bulletstorm, and many more.

notes.title: State of the game - updates on the way!
notes.content:
We’d like to thank all of you for your support for War Mongrels. We’re actively monitoring your reports and feedback, working around the clock to address the identified issues.

Today we’ve deployed the first round of fixes, mostly addressing reported crashes we’ve been able to replicate. You can check the patch notes [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1101790/discussions/0/3117046824712298187/]here[/url].

[/list]

In the meantime, if you like War Mongrels, but have encountered issues or bugs, please give us a bit of time to make it great. Your reviews are very important to us and we’d love for you to let us read them after you’ve had a chance to experience the game of a quality you’ve come to expect from us.

Having worked hard on War Mongrels for a long time, we’ll continue supporting it like we did for our previous games. Stay tuned!
